summary_alerts.html:
CONSENSUS BUY — META (Fields (D) + McCaul (R) + Khanna (D), cross-party)
3 members, combined disclosed value ~$274K. Cross-party accumulation in a mega-cap with AI/advertising exposure suggests members view current valuation as attractive ahead of upcoming catalysts. Cross-aisle agreement reduces the chance the signal reflects partisan policy positioning.

CONSENSUS BUY — PEAK (McCaul (R) + Khanna (D), cross-party)
2 members, combined disclosed value ~$183K. Two members with otherwise differing sector tilts converging on Healthpeak indicates conviction in the medical-office REIT recovery and rate-sensitive yield trade. Worth watching as a defensive income idea.

CONSENSUS BUY — NFLX (Fields (D) + McCaul (R), cross-party)
2 members, combined disclosed value ~$132K. Adds to the mega-cap streaming and advertising thesis already visible in META, suggesting a broader bet on consumer digital advertising rebounding through the quarter.

CONSENSUS SELL — INTU (Khanna (D) + McCaul (R) + Gottheimer (D), cross-party)
3 members, combined disclosed value ~$48K. Three members trimming Intuit across both parties points to concern about software multiples or near-term tax-season guidance. The cross-party nature makes it a notable de-risking signal even at modest dollar size.

CONSENSUS SELL — UBER (McCaul (R) + Khanna (D) + Gottheimer (D), cross-party)
3 members, combined disclosed value ~$32K. Coordinated trimming across three members suggests caution on gig-economy regulatory exposure or take-profit after the run. Small dollar amounts but directionally aligned.

CONSENSUS SELL — HUM (McCaul (R) + Khanna (D), cross-party)
2 members, combined disclosed value ~$83K. A two-member sell in managed care fits broader healthcare-policy uncertainty around Medicare Advantage rate notices.

CONVICTION — David McCormick GS ~$1.23M, 7 purchases
Seven separate Goldman Sachs purchases totaling about $1.23M from a single senator is the highest single-name conviction in the dataset and worth tracking as a standalone idea regardless of cross-member confirmation.
